summary: Shows running a playbook with ansible-playbook (e.g. -f 10 forks) and --verbose for detailed output.
questions: How do I run an Ansible playbook?
How do I get more detailed playbook output?
How do I run a playbook on more hosts in parallel?

answer_card.title: Running a playbook
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-playbook playbook.yml -f 10
```

`-f` sets parallel forks. Add `--verbose` (`-v`) for detailed task output.
